items.title: OpenAI and Anthropic IPOs, volatility in markets after blue wave
items.summary: Host and "The Buy Side" author Turney Duff and his panel of experts weigh in on investment strategy post-midterms, the IPOs of OpenAI and Anthropic, and the impact of the blue wave in Congress on the AI ecosystem. Today's panel includes Hennion & Walsh CIO Kevin Mahn, Neostellar Principal Willy Lee, Grenadilla Advisory Founder and CEO Anna Rathbun, and Futurum Chief Market Strategist Shay Boloor.

items.title: Are Big Tech stock buybacks officially dead?
items.summary: As hyperscalers Alphabet  (GOOGL, GOOG), Amazon (AMZN), Meta (META), and Microsoft  (MSFT) pour billions into AI data centers, stock buybacks appear to be taking a back seat. Repurchases reportedly fell to $4.4 billion in the third quarter, a 90% drop from previous quarters. Yahoo Finance Executive Editor and Sozzi Unleashed host Brian Sozzi examines whether Big Tech's massive AI spending spree is coming at the expense of shareholder returns.
